findings.reason: naming the owner to extend turns §1 from a parallel exit criterion into a parameterised extension of the policy the census already measured against, which is the difference between one exit mechanism and two that drift.
findings.text: the §1 residual-progress exit window ("stop when the retained best iterate stops improving beyond tolerance") duplicates the role of the existing stagnation exit implemented as the `stagnated` predicate in nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py and governed by the shared policy field ForwardSolvePolicy.stagnation_stop (solve_request.py:250) / kernel option stop_on_active_set_stagnation; the reduced route it targets (reduced_newton._drive_trips) exits only on CONVERGED, difference==0 (ACTIVE_SET_SETTLED / SUPPORTED_DECREASE_REFUSED), cycle and budget, so the plan should extend that shared exit policy with a tolerant stagnation/improvement window rather than fork a reduced-only exit family and a new termination reason

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is proposed; the forward work deepens one already-deep module (nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py) behind its existing entry points, which is the opposite of adding surface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §1's residual-progress exit window would add a second exit criterion beside the existing active-set stagnation exit instead of extending the shared policy owner.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass on the supplied counts (public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0) — the design adds no CLI option, MCP view or refusal family, and the new policy knobs it does introduce (an exit-window criterion, a Jacobian-refresh threshold already landed at 6487b487) are fields of the existing ForwardSolvePolicy dataclass, not new public definitions.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design extends machinery that already exists and is cited: §2 restructures nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py (solve_reduced_newton, solve_reduced_newton_compiled, _cached_compiled_program, the batched refused-tail and adaptive-refresh paths all present at HEAD), and §3 reuses the gs-absolute-accuracy certificate and the solver-trip-orchestration census receipts (docs/figures/solver-trip-orchestration/suffix-census.json) rather than inventing new ones.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §2 explicitly forbids a semantics-changing wrapper ("any change here is semantics-preserving by construction; a restructuring that cannot keep them green returns to the lead as a policy question rather than landing"), so no thin layer over existing machinery is proposed.
